reviewer: oauth_identity_audit independent cross-review of UI authored by other agents
scope: Microsoft account migration/authorization UI and API/IPC correlation, write-only custom CurseForge settings controls, FRP credential controls. Excludes this reviewer's backend implementation and all-platform acceptance.
classification: Production renderer screenshots and real Chromium coordinate/key actions in an isolated offscreen Electron profile, synthetic IPC and neutral desktop underlay; code cross-review. No native material or real-service success inferred.

proof.frpMatrix: Same 16 theme/viewport/zoom cases, with configured/replacement failure/locked/clear failure/clear success states
proof.curseforgeScreenshotScope: Same 16 theme/viewport/zoom cases; save failure preserving input, write-only success and explicit clear all pass

rationality.reason: Old accounts keep identity and local context with an explicit reauthorization action; application and account-list failures are distinct; secret inputs use explicit save/clear and explain retained tunnel records. Clear while key storage stays unavailable now has accurate text.

functionality.reason: Current public operation IDs are checked by renderer and carried correctly through API/IPC. Coordinate evidence covers cancelled navigation and old completion rejection, matching completion before begin response, Escape cancellation and opener focus, account-list failure/retry without a second authorization, all-16-matrix write-only key failure/success/clear, and FRP reuse/lock/cancel/failure/success preserving tunnel cards. No critical UI defect remains in this tested scope.

appearance.reason: Original screenshots show readable contrast, existing theme variables and consistent controls. The authorization and destructive confirmation dialogs fit the minimum viewport at 125 percent with visible actions; long pages scroll without horizontal overflow. Individual failure screenshots retain the current error while stale toasts are dismissed through actual controls. Long provider labels and low-priority rows can truncate at 125 percent; native window glass is outside these captures.

resolvedFindings: Cancellation dismissal marker was missing for Escape; corrected and actual keyboard/focus check passes.

Old completion events could dismiss a replacement authorization; operationId contract and actual old-event injection now prevent this. Matching completion delivered before begin response is also directly injected and applied without a stuck modal.
A completed login followed by account-list failure could reject without restoring focus; controlled error, retry and finally-focus restoration now pass.
FRP clear-success text formerly claimed an old credential was retained; revised status accurately distinguishes removed credentials from unavailable key storage.
Earlier rapid-action screenshots stacked old notifications; the final harness closes prior toasts via real coordinate clicks and retains the current state failure.
noncriticalObservations: At minimum size/125 percent, long external-provider labels are clipped and lower account rows require vertical scrolling; main actions remain accessible.
A transient notification can overlap the top of a page; it has a visible dismissal control and the tested target actions remain reachable.
notVerifiedByThisReview: Native DWM/vibrancy, physical desktop window rendering, DPAPI or Keychain interaction.
Real Microsoft/Xbox/Minecraft token chain, ownership, persisted refresh, game launch, actual CurseForge or FRP service operation.
Motion/FPS/audio or original video acceptance; screenshots do not supply such evidence.
All-page or Mac/Windows parity acceptance; remaining features are not scored.
